description: Block commands containing recognized git identity-mutation tokens (ADR 0003; defense in depth, not a shell parser or sandbox; the developer workflow must also run loom-verify-identity after commits) and enforce the write-ahead compaction invariant (ADR 0013). One shared manifest for Claude and Codex (spec 10): the command resolves the hook executable from PLUGIN_ROOT (Codex) falling back to CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT (Claude), evaluated only inside the spawned hook process; each hook script then validates which of those two roots is a real installed loom plugin root and selects its client wire adapter accordingly (spec 08).
